Issue one short-lived grant for an entitled protected model artifact.

Authenticates with the customer's ordinary API key; activation charges
the prepaid audio headroom to the org's credit wallet (402 on rejection).
Acknowledge a replay-safe usage snapshot and refresh the paid grant.
Admin-only: revoke an org's KugelTurn activations (all or one instance).

get.description: Presigned URL for any license-owned file in the weights bucket.

post.description: Authorize a release and return a short-lived direct R2 download URL.

Return the decryption key for a weights image the caller already holds.

Additive: weights arrive in an image now, so nothing downloads here. The
licence key travels in a header rather than the query string, so it does
not land in access logs.
Resolve a customer API key — used by on-prem ingress proxies.

schema.title: Response List Voices V1 License Voices Get

post.description: Synthesize complete text and stream PCM16 audio.
Legacy alias for ``/v1/tts/generate``.

Run text through the TN pipeline (admin testing surface).

The admin web app uses this to test post-override rules: normalize,
diff, add a rule, ``/v1/post-overrides/reload``, normalize again.
The LM path is used when wired; on LM failure the heuristic path
answers instead so the testing surface stays available (matching
v1). Post-overrides apply on both paths via the runtime's wrapped
normalizers.

Drop the post-override snapshot cache for immediate effect.

Called by the admin web app after a rule changes so the next
``/v1/normalize`` observes it instead of waiting out the early TTL.

get.description: Voices visible to the caller: public catalog page + own voices.

post.description:
Create a new voice, optionally with reference audio files.

Accepts either:

- ``application/json`` with a :class:`CreateVoiceRequest` body, or
- ``multipart/form-data`` with a ``metadata`` JSON part and optional
  ``files`` parts (audio files). This is the format sent by the
  Python and JS SDKs when ``reference_files`` are provided.

get.description:
One voice by handle or legacy numeric id.

The caller's org rides along so private/unverified own voices —
which the listing endpoint shows — resolve individually too.

put.description: Upload a PNG, JPEG, or WebP avatar for a voice you can edit.

get.description: List all reference audio files for a voice you own.

schema.title: Response List Voice References V1 Voices  Voice Id  References Get

post.description:
Upload a reference audio file for a voice you own.

Accepts multipart/form-data with a ``file`` field (audio).
Optionally include ``reference_text`` for the transcript.

delete.description: Delete a reference audio file from a voice you own.

post.description:
Request publication (sets pending_verification for admin review).

Verification is admin-controlled and cannot be bypassed via the API.

Generate a sample WAV for a voice you own.

Requires at least one reference audio to be uploaded first. The
sample is generated through the TTS engine under an admission lease
(rate limit + concurrency + size cap) but is never charged — no
usage row is written, matching v1 — and stored via the admin seam.

get.description: List every dictionary belonging to the caller's project.

post.description: Create a new dictionary scoped to the caller's project.

get.description: Fetch a single dictionary by ID.

delete.description: Delete a dictionary (cascades to its entries).

get.description: List entries in a dictionary with optional search and pagination.

post.description: Add a single entry to a dictionary.

put.description:
Replace all entries in the dictionary with the supplied list.

Atomic semantics: upsert every supplied entry by
``(dictionary_id, word)``, then delete any existing entries whose
word is not in the payload. The cache is invalidated once at the
end.

patch.description: Update an entry's word / replacement / ipa / case_sensitive.

post.description:
Invalidate cached dictionary entries for a project.

Internal endpoint — requires master-key authentication. Called by
the web app after dictionary mutations so the TTS backend picks up
changes immediately instead of waiting for the cache TTL to expire.

Cognigy Voice Gateway custom-vendor TTS.

``provider`` is the operator-chosen vendor name from Cognigy's portal.
It identifies *us* to *them* and carries no routing meaning here, so it
is accepted as-is and only logged.
Generate speech from text (ElevenLabs compatible).
Streaming alias — same audio stream as the non-stream endpoint.

get.description: All voices visible to the caller: public catalog + authorized voices.

Get one voice by handle or legacy numeric id.

Actor-scoped exactly like ``GET /v1/voices``: that listing returns the
caller's authorized private / unverified voices, so the detail endpoint
the ElevenLabs SDK calls right after it must resolve them too. Passing the
complete authentication context lets the directory enforce project and
user grants instead of treating organization membership as sufficient.

Contract change (was anonymous): the endpoint now authenticates, for
the same reason its sibling listing does — private access needs an actor.

Available models in the ElevenLabs shape, one entry per alias.

Returns a bare JSON array — the official API shape; the official SDK
(``client.models.list()``) parses ``List[Model]`` and breaks on any
wrapper object.

schema.title: Response Get Models 11Labs V1 Models Get

post.description:
Vapi custom TTS webhook.

With ``message.call.id``: clause POSTs of one agent turn share a
TTS session (KV continuation). Without it (test harness, non-Vapi
callers): a stateless one-shot synthesis.

BulkReplaceEntriesRequest.title: BulkReplaceEntriesRequest
BulkReplaceEntriesRequest.description:
Atomic upsert + delete-missing replacement of all entries in a dictionary.

Idempotent: callers sending the same payload twice converge to the
same final state. Entries in the existing dictionary whose ``word``
is not in ``entries`` are deleted; entries whose ``word`` matches
are upserted.

dictionary_ids.title: Dictionary Ids
dictionary_ids.description: Per-request dictionary selection. Omit for the default behavior (all active dictionaries of the project apply, filtered by language). An empty list disables dictionaries for this request. A list of dictionary IDs applies exactly those dictionaries — including inactive ones — bypassing the language filter.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: Combined codec+rate token (e.g. 'pcm_8000', 'ulaw_8000', 'alaw_8000'). Opt-in; when set it is authoritative and must not contradict 'sample_rate'. Absent ⇒ legacy 'sample_rate' path (linear PCM16).

Response from ``POST /v1/audio/transcriptions``.

Fields beyond this declared subset (e.g. ``entities``,
``audio_quality``) are preserved by ``extra="allow"`` and reach the
caller verbatim — the ingress is a passthrough.

turn, grows between turns. Items are never introspected.
